text: Professional Overview：The Food Science and Engineering major is based on chemistry, biology and engineering. It mainly studies modern food processing methods, processes and equipment, covering aspects such as food nutrition and health, process design and social production, food processing and storage as well as food safety and hygiene. It serves as an important bridge connecting food science and industrial engineering.Training Objectives：Cultivate qualified builders and reliable successors of the socialist cause who are well-rounded in morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics and labor. Students are required to master the basic knowledge of natural science and the fundamental theories and practical skills of food science and engineering, possess the ability to conduct food research and development, management and solve complex engineering problems, have a good cultural background and scientific literacy, have the awareness of innovation and entrepreneurship and an international perspective, and be able to work in related fields such as food processing, circulation and sales. Engage in work related to food science research, supervision and management, product development, engineering design, production management, logistics and sales, etc.Core courses：It includes food chemistry, food nutrition, food safety, food technology, food analysis, food processing equipment and intelligent manufacturing, food factory design and environmental protection, etc.
